exe:FUNCTION__XCLIM_CONVERT_UNITS.sdo:name: Convert units
exe:FUNCTION__XCLIM_CONVERT_UNITS.sdo:description: Convert a mathematical expression into a value with the same units as a DataArray.

exe:FUNCTION__CDO_SUB.sdo:name: sub - subtract two fields
exe:FUNCTION__CDO_SUB.sdo:description: This module performs simple arithmetic of two datasets. The number of fields in ifile1 should be the same as in ifile2. One of the input files can contain only one timestep or one variable. The fields in ofile inherit the meta data from ifile1 or ifile2.

exe:FUNCTION__CDO_SELYEAR.sdo:name: selyear - select a year range
exe:FUNCTION__CDO_SELYEAR.sdo:description: This module selects a year range in the input field.

exe:FUNCTION__CDO_YEARSUM.sdo:name: Year sum
exe:FUNCTION__CDO_YEARSUM.sdo:description: This module computes the sum of the input field over a year.
